::: {.why}
The audit is only worth running once, so today is spent making sure that when it runs, every model is on identical footing and no configuration was chosen with the test data in view.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Fix and commit the audit protocol: the same test set, the same features, the same costs and the same portfolio construction for every model.
- State which decisions were made before the test set was set aside and which were not.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>65 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Write the audit configuration: test period, universe, feature set, label, weighting, portfolio construction, cost model, and the metric with its interval method. One file, committed, with the commit timestamp as the evidence that it predates the run.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Write the honest provenance note: for each model, when its hyperparameters were fixed and against what data. Any model whose configuration was influenced by something you learned from the test period is marked as such, and marking it is better than pretending otherwise.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [10 min]{.task-min} Verify by dry run: execute the audit on the validation period rather than the test period, to confirm the pipeline runs end to end for every model before the one run that counts.
:::
:::

:::
